title: Space scientist David W. Webb and government awareness of abductions

tellings.quote: Uh I was aware by then uh that there were people inside the government who had had a certain amount of contact because I had met uh a space scientist David W. web

plain: By the mid 1980s, when strange visits were happening at his cabin in upstate New York, the writer Whitley Strieber already knew that some people inside the government had had contact with beings. He says he learned this from meeting a space scientist named David W. Webb. Strieber tells it himself, as part of his own account of being visited, and as a sign that officials knew about such experiences.
